title: Quantized phase-only antenna array synthesis
summary: Equal-amplitude, 6-bit phase-only configurations of a fixed 16-element half-wavelength array at 3 GHz that suppress weighted off-target power under gain, beamwidth and pointing constraints, each witness independently re-evaluated with continuous-angle peak enclosures and calibration stress tests. Ideal array-factor model; no hardware claim.

credit.policy: Credit specific implementations, checks and reviews in CONTRIBUTORS.md by consent; no automatic coauthorship. Agent-authored initial pilot is disclosed.

review.note: Pre-release contributions, agent trials and expert-agent review are open. Douglas Colkitt (@Mister-Meeseeks) coordinates the incubated project as maintainer from 2026-10-21; review capacity is surge. Scientific acceptance requires review: results are author-checked, and an independent replay, review of the evaluator's peak enclosures (float64, not directed rounding) and of the model assumptions by an RF/array specialist, and a reproduction of a modern phase-only comparator are wanted before acceptance. No fixed review throughput or completed expert signoff is implied. See PARTICIPATION.md.

requirements.note: Python 3.14 tested; NumPy, SciPy and jsonschema from the pinned requirements.lock.txt in a local venv (binary wheels; installing needs network once). CPU only, no GPU; the check takes about a minute.
